mathematics.assertion_tested: For supplied finite rational trace tables, finite_frobenius_separator agrees with independent exact matrix rank, marks its certificate valid iff the table has full column rank, rejects require() on rank-deficient tables, and exactly recovers sampled multiplicity vectors when full rank.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact integers and fractions over Q; independent reference rank via SymPy exact Matrix.rank.
mathematics.conventions: Rows are supplied Frobenius places; columns are declared constituents; separation means full column rank of the finite trace matrix.
non_claims: The finite computation does not prove Chebotarev density or any global Galois/automorphic identification theorem.
The random audit is implementation evidence; the full-column-rank uniqueness statement is proved separately by exact linear algebra.
The audit does not prove every deformation or Frobenius-related API is globally bug-free.

checks: certificate.require() accepts exactly the separating cases
exact sampled multiplicity recovery on full-rank tables
result: Implementation and finite assertion verified in the stated range: 1800/1800 tables agreed with independent exact rank, with zero certificate or recovery failures.
residual_risks: Schema version 1 does not pin hashes of execution inputs.
SymPy is used as the independent finite-rank oracle but is still software, not a formal proof assistant.
Global arithmetic interpretation beyond the supplied finite table remains an explicit unchecked assumption.
